desc: Run exhaustive brute force (N<=4, A_i<=5), tabulate winner vs features (N parity, cnt_odd, min A, count of min, second min, sorted A), and fit the true closed-form rule; verify the survivor-pair parity formula by exact solution of the elimination game.

Prove the criterion rigorously: show total moves T = N + U where U = sum of (A_i-1) over the first N-2 discovered indices (all such passes are eventually used), so the winner depends only on the survivor pair; then solve the alternating elimination game (who controls which two indices survive, given pass tokens can shift elimination order) via backward induction on parity classes.
Validate the fitted rule against the brute-force DP on random small cases (N<=7, A_i<=9); if it fails anywhere, re-fit before proceeding.
Implement the verified criterion as an O(N log N) or O(N) solution reading N and array from stdin, printing Fennec/Snuke, with no brute-force guard left in the final code.
Test final code on the three provided samples and edge cases (N=1 always Fennec, all A_i=1 winner = parity of N, N=2 always Snuke, large A_i up to 1e9).
